tokyo_la_beaute_yotsuya.gf_detail: Ask. The hot pots finish as risotto or rice porridge, and lunch is soup, salad and multigrain rice, but appetizers include spring rolls and croquettes and the desserts include pound cake; nothing gluten-free is described.
tokyo_la_beaute_yotsuya.vegan_detail: Ask. Over 20 vegetables go into each hot pot, but the broths named are soft-shell turtle with bonito, chicken bone, tomato or basil with meat, fish or seafood, and the lunch soups include clam chowder and chicken; no vegan option is stated.
tokyo_la_beaute_yotsuya.hours_raw: Mon–Fri lunch 11:30–14:00 and dinner 17:00–23:00; Sat and holidays dinner 17:00–23:00; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Lunch bookings only for 4 or more or for the lunch hot-pot course; dinner bookings any time (Tabelog). Lunch fills at opening (January 2025). 20 seats: a counter of 6 and four tables; whole-shop hire up to 20; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards accepted (Tabelog).
tokyo_la_beaute_yotsuya.notes: [Hot pot · Yotsuya, herbal hot pots from a one-person kitchen] A calm second-floor room in a Yotsuya back lane where one owner cooks and serves herbal hot pots with an Italian accent: two broths side by side — tomato and basil for the "Anti-Aging Nabe", soft-shell turtle and spicy chicken bone for the beauty pot, curry and salt for the detox pot — with twenty-odd vegetables, your choice of meat or fish, and a risotto or porridge to finish. Weekday lunch is a bargain: two herbal soups, salad and multigrain rice for about ¥1,000, and the place fills at opening. Save room for the owner's ice cream, drawn from more than 300 recipes and flavours found on travels, such as red wine and fig. Diners in 2025–26 praise the food and the owner's warmth.

chef_bio.background: No source names the owner. "Surprisingly, there was only one staff member managing everything" (January 2025); "Although it is run by just one person, the service is prompt" (February 2025); "The owner changes the ice cream flavors daily" (October 2025); "over 300 recipes! The owner has traveled to many countries and uses ingredients discovered during [those] travels in [the] ice cream" (May 2026). Tabelog: herbal ingredients chosen with care to make traditional Chinese medicine easy to enjoy; at least 12 vegetables per hot pot; seasonal hot pots. A March 2025 diner notes the building's first floor is Osteria Pinocchio.
chef_bio.philosophy: To make medicinal cuisine more accessible and delicious (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Herbal hot pots; homemade ice cream.

anecdotes.text: "For dessert, I chose the owner's special ice cream, with about seven flavors to choose from. The red wine and fig ice cream was incredibly delicious." — October 2025.
"I could choose between large, medium, or small portions of rice at the same price." — January 2025, half-and-half herbal soup lunch.
"They offer three types of hot pots: medicinal hot pot, beauty hot pot, and detox hot pot." — March 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ラ・ボーテ、鍋・イタリアン・ダイニングバー、四谷2-3-19 四谷大新ビル2F、南北線四ツ谷駅2番出口から徒歩3分、JR四ツ谷口5分、月〜金11:30〜14:00・17:00〜23:00、土・祝17:00〜23:00、日曜休み、ランチの予約は4名以上か鍋ランチコースのみ、20席 (カウンター6、テーブル)、貸切20名、禁煙、カード可、イタリアン薬膳鍋「アンチエイジング鍋」、トマトとバジルのスープ、野菜は最低12種。口コミ(2025年1月〜2026年5月): 店主ひとりで営む、薬膳スープ2種のランチ900〜1,000円、14穀米、すっぽんと鶏ガラの美容鍋、カレーと塩のデトックス鍋、締めのリゾットや雑炊、自家製アイスは300種以上のレシピ、薬膳酒。

cultural_comfort.note: One person cooks and serves; book dinner; set hot pots make ordering easy.

tokyo_kitajima_tei_yotsuya.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Classic French with bread and butter, a bacon quiche among the amuses, flour-dusted fish, butter and cream sauces, tarts and baked sweets (2026 reviews); nothing gluten-free is described.
tokyo_kitajima_tei_yotsuya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat, foie gras, fish and shellfish courses with butter and cream.
tokyo_kitajima_tei_yotsuya.hours_raw: Mon and Thu–Sun (and holidays) lunch 11:30–15:00 (last food order 12:30) and dinner 18:00–22:00 (last food order 19:00); closed Tuesday and Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations by phone; an August 2026 diner was offered a weekday the following month (Japanese review). Service charge 10% (Tabelog). 12 seats at tables; whole-shop hire; non-smoking (Tabelog; September 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Allow about 3 hours (August 2026).
tokyo_kitajima_tei_yotsuya.notes: [French · Yotsuya, a classic bistro of big portions under a yellow awning] Behind a faded yellow awning in Yotsuya Sanei-cho, a 12-seat French restaurant that the shop says has been a standout for about a quarter of a century, cooked by chef Motoyuki Kitajima in an unfashionably generous, butter-and-sauce classical style. Courses of three or four dishes (¥16,940 or ¥18,150, the same price for 12 years, says one regular) arrive with amuses, granité, dessert and a box of petits fours, and many diners can't finish: the famous Nemuro sea-urchin consommé jelly, foie gras with corn galette, flounder in a potato crust with a dense fish-soup sauce. 2026 diners loved the cucumber soup, the uni and the wine pairings; others found the sauces rough, the lamb fatty, a fish slightly off and the precision behind the volume, and one regular wonders how long the ageing chef will keep cooking. Book by phone; closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays.

roles: Chef (Tabelog: "Motoyuki Kitajima - A Gourmet Explorer Who Mastered the Essence")
chef_bio.background: Tabelog (shop text): a French restaurant with a striking yellow-and-blue front, "a standout for nearly a quarter of a century"; the chef wants to "master the essence", avoiding trendy techniques and complex presentation for robust dishes that maximise the ingredients. Tabelog Award Bronze 2017–2020 and 2026; French TOKYO "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2023, 2025. A September 2026 diner calls it one of the "Four Kings of Japanese French Cuisine"; another writes "Given that Chef Kitajima is getting older, I wonder how much longer [the chef] will be active." No source gives the kanji of the chef's given name.
chef_bio.philosophy: To master the essence: no trends, no fuss, maximum flavour from the ingredients (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Uni consommé jelly; foie gras with corn galette; generous classic courses.

anecdotes.text: 「メニューはコースが3品(16940円)・4品(18150円)の2種類…北島亭では12年前から値段が据え置かれていました。」 — August 2026, a return after 12 years.

"Although it's called a '4-dish' course, it actually includes four selected dishes along with soup, appetizers, palate cleansers, desserts, and baked sweets… I couldn't finish the last baked sweet, so I took it home." — September 2026.

"The quantity was substantial, something not often seen in recent Tokyo French cuisine… However, I felt that the precision and delicacy of the dishes did not quite match the volume." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 北島亭、フレンチ、四谷三栄町15-2 JHCビル1F、四ツ谷駅から徒歩5分、月・木〜日・祝11:30〜15:00 (料理L.O.12:30)・18:00〜22:00 (料理L.O.19:00)、火曜・水曜休み、サービス料10%、12席、禁煙、カード可、食べログアワード Bronze 2017〜2020・2026、フレンチ TOKYO 百名店2021・2023・2025、シェフは Motoyuki Kitajima。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): コースは3品16,940円と4品18,150円 (12年前から据え置きという声)、きゅうりの冷製スープ、雲丹のコンソメジュレ、紅ズワイガニとアスパラガスのシャルロット仕立てのサラダ、フォアグラのポワレととうもろこしのガレット、平目のじゃがいもづけ焼き、蔵王の鴨のロースト、紅茶のプリン、小菓子6種、量が多い、黄色いテント、仕上げが粗いという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone; choose dishes within the course; shared choices for groups.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (Bronze 2026); reviews dated through October 2026.

tokyo_eishinkan_bakery_yotsuya.gf_detail: Ask. A September 2026 diner reports the signature kinako butter bread is made by wrapping kinako butter in a rice-flour dough, but nothing is labelled gluten-free and the shop also bakes croissants, Danish, pizza and other breads in the same kitchen.
tokyo_eishinkan_bakery_yotsuya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the signature bread is filled with Hokkaido cream butter, and the range includes butter breads, egg mayo, sausage and pizza.
tokyo_eishinkan_bakery_yotsuya.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 10:00–15:00; closed Wednesday, Saturday, Sunday and holidays (Tabelog), though an October 2026 diner bought bread on a Saturday afternoon. The kinako butter bread is baked several times a day and other breads sell out by the afternoon (March and September 2026). A free coffee, tea or rooibos with any bread purchase (2025–26 reviews). 6 seats at three small tables (Tabelog; September 2026). E-money and QR such as PayPay; no cards (Tabelog; October 2026). Bakery opened January 2021 (February and September 2026 reviews).
tokyo_eishinkan_bakery_yotsuya.notes: [Bakery · Yotsuya, the inn's kinako butter bread] A tiny bakery in the entrance of the Eishinkan, a long-running inn on the corner of Yotsuya Saka-machi, opened in 2021 to share the bread served at the inn's breakfast with the neighbourhood. The draw is the kinako butter bread, ¥260: organic roasted-soy flour and Hokkaido cream butter wrapped in a rice-flour dough, crunchy on top and molten inside when it comes from the oven several times a day. Daily sweet and savoury breads, a pizza of the week and mini sizes fill the case, and every purchase comes with a free coffee or tea at one of three little tables in the sunlight. Go before lunch for the full range. Open four weekdays, 10:00–15:00.

chef_bio.origin: Bakery opened January 2021 in the Eishinkan inn (2026 reviews); the inn: "Our main business, Eishinkan, has been operating at its current location since 1953" (Tabelog); "established in 1935" per a September 2026 review.
chef_bio.background: No source names the owner or bakers. Tabelog remarks: "Our main business, Eishinkan, has been operating at its current location since 1953." Reviews describe the inn as in business for 87 or 90 years (February and January 2026) and established in 1935 (September 2026); the bakery was opened "with the intention of sharing the bread served at breakfast with the local community" (September 2026). An event stall at Ikebukuro Tobu is mentioned (December 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: Sharing the inn's breakfast bread with the neighbourhood (September 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: "I arrived just in time for the freshly baked bread! The kinako butter inside was still hot and melting, so I was warned to hold it carefully and eat it straight away." — March 2026.
"This round bread is made by wrapping organic soybean kinako and Hokkaido fresh cream butter in a rice flour dough and baking it." — September 2026.
"When you buy bread, they offer a complimentary drink, so I enjoyed a warm rooibos tea." — December 2025.
